business_problem: Growth Protocol needed to build an enterprise reasoning platform for regulated industries that could combine large-scale data pipelines with deterministic recommendations while guaranteeing zero data retention for sensitive customer information.
solution_summary: Growth Protocol built its Enterprise Reasoning Platform on Google Cloud by combining BigQuery, Cloud Run, Gemini platform, and Gemini with its own neuro-symbolic reasoning layer and Elastic search. BigQuery and GKE-scale data pipelines handle the large industrial and insurance datasets behind the service, while Gemini platform and Model Garden provide the managed model environment used to productionize internal models and interpret user intent. Gemini’s enterprise security posture and zero-data-retention controls were essential because the company works with regulated customers that cannot allow private information into model-training loops. Cloud Run helps package the reasoning service into scalable application workflows. This combination let Growth Protocol grow quickly while keeping the platform deterministic enough to return clear executive recommendations and flexible enough to deploy frontier reasoning capabilities without repeated re-platforming.
